highlights.summary: GENEVA, Oct 30 – The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has opened registration for experts to review the First Order Draft of the 2027 IPCC Methodology Report on Carbon Dioxide Removal Technologies, Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories (Additional guidance).
